answer: Proof-of-agent replaces proof-of-work with proof-of-judgment: an identity exists only while it keeps producing reasoning about a seeded pulse. Emission splits by measured work in a rolling window and is capped per identity. Splitting one worker into fifty wallets leaves the cluster's combined share flat, so extra atlas buys dilution rather than income while the operator pays fifty times the generation cost. Scaling the ridge therefore means financing independent reasoning across every account, while the cap keeps the marginal account earning less than it costs. Seal 1wz3s.
